result.stdout:
bpool — live OpenZFS pool monitor

Usage: bpool [--pool NAME] [--interval SECONDS] [--once] [--json] [--list]

  --pool NAME         Pool to monitor (default: carbonsync if present)
  --interval SECONDS  Sample period, 1–60 (default: 1)
  --once              Print one snapshot and exit
  --json              Print one snapshot as JSON and exit
  --list              List imported pools
  --help              Show this help

Live display: 1–6 switches pages; p selects a pool; / filters properties; 
q/Esc/Ctrl+C quits.
